result.title: Graph Metanetworks for Transformer Based Language Models
result.summary: Weight-space learning treats the weights of neural networks as data, processed by other models called metanetworks. A key challenge is that different weights can realize the same function, related by a group of symmetries the metanetwork should respect. While symmetry-aware metanetworks for simple architectures such as MLPs are well developed, a comprehensive treatment of transformers, and in particular transformer-based language models, is still missing. Importantly, their weight space has a richer symmetry group: beyond neuron permutations, attention introduces continuous general-linear symmetries of the attention matrices and permutations of entire heads. Existing methods for transformer weights either capture only part of these symmetries or are restricted to a single, fixed architecture, and none accounts for language-model-specific components such as the token embeddings. Building on graph metanetworks, we propose a graph-based approach that is both symmetry-aware and applicable across depths and widths. We formalize a weight-space symmetry group of complete decoder-only language models and provide a graph construction that is invariant to it. We further introduce two new transformer-population datasets with novel tasks, such as training-corpus prediction and fine-tuning detection, on which our approach notably outperforms existing baselines.

AI.brief_summary: 论文为基于 Transformer 的语言模型提出对称感知的图元网络：形式化完整 decoder-only LM 权重空间的对称群，构造对深度、宽度可迁移且对该群不变的图表示，并发布两个 Transformer 权重数据集及训练语料预测、微调检测等新任务。
AI.relevance_reason: 「不同权重可实现同一函数」的对称等价与 LVR 中潜状态、注意力配置的非唯一性存在概念类比，其群论形式化与等变构造或可供核查是否能用于刻画注意力结构与潜表示几何，但原文不涉及视觉推理。
